description: Phase 6au gate — multi-column table-level PRIMARY KEY. Composite PK enforces tuple uniqueness and creates an auto-index.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b));
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY a, b;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b));

cases.name: composite-pk-single-member-duplicate-ok
cases.description: Duplicate of a single PK member is allowed as long as the tuple differs.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b));

cases.name: composite-pk-null-member-rejected
cases.description: NULL in any PK column raises NOT_NULL_VIOLATION (composite PK columns are implicitly NOT NULL).

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b));
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b, c));

cases.name: composite-pk-multiple-pk-clauses-rejected
cases.description: Combining column-level PK with table-level PK is a compile error.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, b));
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (a, zzz));
